resources.string: No transcript yet. Choose a speech model and let the phone listen to the audio tracks (nothing leaves the phone).
Tap a word to jump there. Tap another word to select everything in between.
Deleting cuts the words out of the video and sound on the targeted tracks and closes the gap. Captions in the range are shortened, but their text is not changed.

resources.string: Listen again, for example in another language or at a higher quality. The new transcript replaces the old one.
No transcript yet. Transcribe the clip and pick its sentences as text – nothing leaves the phone.
Tap a sentence to mark it, tap another to extend. Then Insert or Overwrite.
Pauses and filler words are removed on all unlocked tracks, and the gaps close.
No track is targeted or sync-locked – nothing would be removed. Tap a track header in the timeline to target it.
What comes after moves %1$s s earlier on those tracks.
Nothing comes after it on those tracks.
Left as they are: %1$s (not targeted or sync-locked, or locked) – they can fall out of step.
